title: Promoter sequence interaction and structure based multi-targeted (redox regulatory genes) molecular docking analysis of vitamin E and curcumin in T4 induced oxidative stress model using H9C2 cardiac cell line.
authors: Mishra, Pallavi; Tandon, Gitanjali; Kumar, Manoj; Paital, Biswaranjan; Swain, Shasanka Sekhar; Kumar, Sunil; Samanta, Luna
one_liner_zh: 该文通过分子对接分析维生素E和姜黄素与氧化应激相关蛋白及其启动子区的相互作用，但核心是药物-蛋白/药物-DNA对接，非TF-DNA结合机制研究，且方法为传统对接，缺乏AI或MD深度建模。
abstract: A positive association between oxidative stress and hyper-thyroid conditions is well established. Vitamin E (VIT-E) and curcumin (CRM) are considered as potent antioxidant small molecules. Nuclear factor erythroid 2-related factor 2(NRF-2) is known to bind with antioxidant response element and subsequently activate expression of antioxidant enzymes. However, the activation of NRF-2 depends on removal of its regulator Kelch-like ECH-associated protein 1(NRF-2). In the current study, an attempt is made to demonstrate whether effects of VIT-E and CRM are due to direct interaction with the target proteins (i.e. NRF-2, NRF-2, SOD, catalase and LDH) or by possible interaction with the flanking region of their promoters by in silico analysis. Further, these results were corroborated by pretreatment of H9C2 cells (1 x 10(6) cells per mL of media) with VIT-E (50 muM) and/or CRM (20 muM) for 24 h followed by induction of oxidative stress via T4 (100 nm) administration and assaying the active oxygen metabolism. Discriminant function analyses (DFA) indicated that T4 has a definite role in increasing oxidative stress as evidenced by induction of ROS generation, increase in mitochondrial membrane potential and elevated lipid peroxidation (LPx). Pretreatment with the two antioxidants have ameliorative effects more so when given in combination. The decline in biological activities of the principal antioxidant enzymes SOD and CAT with respect to T4 treatment and its restoration in antioxidant pretreated group further validated our in silico data. Communicated by Ramaswamy H. Sarma.
abstract_zh: 氧化应激与甲状腺功能亢进状态之间的正相关性已得到充分证实。维生素E（VIT-E）和姜黄素（CRM）被认为是强效的抗氧化小分子。核因子E2相关因子2（NRF-2）已知能与抗氧化反应元件结合，并随后激活抗氧化酶的表达。然而，NRF-2的激活依赖于其调节因子Kelch样ECH相关蛋白1（NRF-2）的去除。在本研究中，尝试通过计算机模拟分析来证明VIT-E和CRM的作用是否源于与靶蛋白（即NRF-2、NRF-2、SOD、过氧化氢酶和LDH）的直接相互作用，或通过与它们启动子侧翼区域的潜在相互作用。此外，这些结果通过H9C2细胞（每毫升培养基1 x 10(6)个细胞）预处理VIT-E（50 μM）和/或CRM（20 μM）24小时，随后通过T4（100 nM）给药诱导氧化应激并测定活性氧代谢来进一步验证。判别函数分析（DFA）表明，T4在增加氧化应激方面具有明确作用，这通过诱导ROS生成、线粒体膜电位升高和脂质过氧化（LPx）水平升高得以证实。两种抗氧化剂的预处理具有改善作用，尤其是在联合使用时更为显著。主要抗氧化酶SOD和CAT相对于T4处理的生物活性下降，以及在抗氧化剂预处理组中的恢复，进一步验证了我们的计算机模拟数据。由Ramaswamy H. Sarma通讯。
